snippet.title: The Phantom - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The Ghost Who Walks is back! Comics' very first costumed hero is coming to Steam and console in an all-new side-scrolling beat-em-up adventure. Take on the Singh brotherhood across the globe with only your physical strength, skill with weapons, and fearsome reputation!
Coming soon to Steam, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch.

Subscribe to our newsletter at our Official Site:
https://www.thephantomgame.com/

Wishlist the game here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2444160/The_Phantom/

Follow us on our social media:
Twitter - https://twitter.com/_phantomgame
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/phantomgameofficial/
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/phantomgameofficial/

And join our Discord Server:
https://discord.gg/pu7NUjp2E3
